title: Aloe vera tincture for medicinal use
intro: Aloe vera tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made by soaking the gel from the Aloe vera plant in alcohol or another solvent. It is commonly used in herbalism to treat skin conditions, inflammation, and digestive issues due to its soothing and healing properties. The tincture is valued for its ability to promote wound healing and reduce irritation. It is often taken internally in small doses to support gut health and detoxification. Herbalists also use it topically to alleviate symptoms of eczema, psoriasis, and sunburn.
